# MyBuildingPermit Permit Search

> > Centralized permit search and status tracking system for building permits across multiple jurisdictions in the Puget Sound region of Washington State.

MyBuildingPermit provides a unified interface to search and track building permit applications, statuses, and records across cities including Auburn, Bellevue, Bothell, Burien, Edmonds, Federal Way, Issaquah, Kenmore, Kirkland, Mercer Island, Mill Creek, Newcastle, Sammamish, and King County. The platform enables searches by permit number, parcel number, address, and contractor information.

## Key Topics

- Permit search and status tracking
- Building permit applications
- Multi-jurisdiction permit lookup
- King County permit system
- Puget Sound area jurisdictions (Auburn, Bellevue, Bothell, Burien, Edmonds, Federal Way, Issaquah, Kenmore, Kirkland, Mercer Island, Mill Creek, Newcastle, Sammamish)
- Parcel-based permit search
- Contractor permit lookup
- Address-based permit queries
- Permit application status
- Regional building permit database

## Permit Search Portal

- [Permit Status - MyBuildingPermit](https://permitsearch.mybuildingpermit.com/): Main permit search interface for looking up building permit status and records across multiple jurisdictions in the Puget Sound region
